intro: Rwag is the orc rogue trainer stationed in the Den, tucked within Durotar's Valley of Trials. He instructs newly arrived orcs and trolls in the arts of stealth, subterfuge, and dirty fighting under the watchful gaze of the Horde.

p: Operating deep within the cave known as the Den, Rwag trains fledgling rogues, cutpurses, and thieves before they step out into the wider world of Durotar. While the new Horde champions martial honor and battlefield valor, Rwag understands that subtlety, poisons, and a well-placed dagger remain invaluable tools for survival in an unforgiving desert. He keeps a sharp eye on Valley business and harbors deep suspicions regarding the dark practitioners also sheltering in the cave, particularly the warlock Nartok.
